description: On-site door-hardware test runbook for the VFT/ZKTeco access-control campaign. Canonical task definitions; live status is the "Door Hardware Runbook" artifact database. Brief: docs/architecture/access-control-hardware-session.md.

rounds.title: A finger, a scan, a door
rounds.goal: Every remaining do-not-ship case and the simulator plan's top eight: enrolment, first scans, the end-date boundary, cancel/rejoin, the offline premise, reboot, ambiguity, the races.

rounds.title: Time, failure and the honest screen
rounds.goal: Clock skew and midnight on the reader's clock, interrupted/offline enrolment, power and network loss, withdrawal semantics, device-local enrolment, duplicates, reconcile blind spots, the events pull, and every screen that could say something false.

rounds.title: Concurrency, ambiguity, recovery, acceptance
rounds.goal: The race matrix, lost replies, crashed workers, a forgotten reader, ordering, condensed real days, a one-hour soak, the five-source audit, acceptance gates and the readiness verdict.
